exact_transition_checks.condition: Every affected key and authority is present in the transition receipt.
The stored value matches the cited exact source bytes.
Source, event, action, parent, and content identities are complete.
Every frozen old-family anchor remains exact.
A later exact correction invalidates the affected write.
A tombstoned write cannot return during replay.
Fresh replay produces the same state bytes.
Restart restores the same state bytes and checksum.
Rollback restores the exact parent bytes and checksum.
